vision.name: Buu
vision.text:
(At the start of the game, you may search your Life Deck for all copies of "Buu's Candy," "Buu's Chocolate," and "Buu's Cookie" and banish them.)
[Continuous]: Your opponent's attacks deal -1 stage of damage.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
Raise your anger 1 level. Rejuvenate 1.
DAMAGE: 3 stages.
HIT: You may discard a card from your hand to draw a card or Rejuvenate 2.
